description: Land Title Settlement Department - Alawala, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420080
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 99, Block 01) in Alawala village.
